import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()

LONG_CTX = "...big knowledge base here..." * 200

def ask(q: str) -> str:
    msg = client.messages.create(
        model="{{model_name}}",
        max_tokens=512,
        system=[
            {"type": "text", "text": LONG_CTX, "cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}},
        ],
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": q}],
    )
    return msg.content[0].text
